definition: Unique identifier assigned to each artist record in the production workforce.

definition: Primary VFX production department to which the artist is assigned.

definition: Artist’s assigned office location or remote-work region.
valid_values: Atlanta; London; Los Angeles; Montreal; Vancouver; Remote-US; Remote-EU.
cleaning_expectation: Trim whitespace and standardize values to the approved location labels.

warning_resolution: The field is logically numeric even though dirty source values caused it to load as text. Invalid or unusual capacities will be corrected or documented before utilization analysis.

definition: Fictional internal hourly labor-cost rate used to estimate artist and project labor cost.

definition: Date the artist began employment with the fictional VFX studio.
